therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Expert system algorithms using branched chain decision trees to systematically acquire patient medical histories
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Improved detection and documentation of medical problems through structured data acquisition
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Hospitalized patients requiring medical history taking
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Detection of medical problems not identified by physician-taken history

results.effect_size: 98 medical problems detected by computer-assisted history that were not reported by physician-taken history
results.target_engagement_evidence: Expert system successfully acquired medical histories through direct patient interview using pathophysiology-based algorithms

context.indication: Multiple conditions requiring medical history taking (hypertension, diabetes, hypercholesterolemia, vasculitis, coronary heart disease)
context.duration: Duration of hospital stay, average 8 days
